claims.claimText: For a formal UQ student misconduct proceeding, the scheduled hearing follows at least 10 business days after the allegation notice and document bundle are provided to the student. An oral hearing occurs only if requested, and a student may bring a support person. A student is not entitled to a lawyer or representative unless the Misconduct Body chair gives prior written approval. The Body will endeavour to decide within 20 business days after the notice and bundle are provided; this is an endeavour, not a fixed deadline.

claims.claimText: An appeal of a Misconduct Body penalty ordinarily suspends implementation, unless the body directs implementation despite appeal. A student may ask the Appeal Body chair to stay such a direction; the chair must consider that request urgently. The Appeal Body decision is final within UQ, after which a student may complain to the National Student Ombudsman; internal appeals should usually be exhausted first.
